summary: Collision/system config key lookup and re-init (thiscall). Sets this[0] to 1 (matched), then compares the key argument a2 against 68 known global config addresses in a long if/else chain; on a match stores the matched global's address in this[7] (offset 0x1C), otherwise clears this[7] and this[0] and records failure. When a match was found, writes the a3 value into the matched global at offset +8. Always calls SwapAndReinit on the trailing field block (count 89), clears this[8] (offset 0x20) and returns the status (0 on match, -1 on no match). Called by ShortComputation_30a0 (004530A0).

local_names.this: config-key lookup object whose slot 7 caches the matched global address
local_names.a2: candidate config key value to resolve against the known global table
local_names.a3: new config value written into the matched global at its +8 field
local_names.v4: return status accumulator (0 success / -1 no match)
local_names.v5: resolved global address from this[7], used as the write target

operations.description: Sets this[0] (offset 0x0) to 1 at entry as the optimistic matched flag
If/else chain compares a2 against 68 known global config addresses (each read-only); on equality stores that global's own address into this[7] (offset 0x1C)
No-match branch: clears this[7] and this[0], and records the failure status -1 in v4
When a match was found (this[7] non-zero), writes the a3 value into the matched global at its +8 field
SwapAndReinit(this+1, 89, 0) reinitialises the trailing field block (including offset 0x24) with element count 89 and zero fill
Returns the status: 0 when a key matched, -1 when no global matched
